reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream needs window, maps only exact need text to the supplied capabilities, and correctly leaves records without matching capabilities unsupported. No independent market-demand inference is introduced at this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid generic keyword or unrelated capability matches
keep missing capability evidence visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs reverses the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage is direct. This makes covered capabilities look unsupported, demotes the genuinely unsupported demand records, and drives the final recommendation to prioritize an already-covered need.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve consequences of missing or contradictory demand evidence
produce deterministic recommendation from correctly ranked demand priorities

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item priority window and deterministically uses the first ranked priority. The incorrect recommendation is downstream of the bad unsupported flag and ordering supplied by prioritize_needs, not a separate synthesis defect.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records keeps all rows with demand_score at least 3 and preserves the explicit fallback ids, producing the full observed demand set without adding background-only demand claims.
normalize_evidence constrains records to the allowed eight-record window, fills missing fields with neutral JSON-safe sentinels, and preserves the bounded demand evidence needed by downstream review.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve missing-field visibility with neutral sentinels

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance builds ranked evidence-source records from normalized needs using demand_score ordering and preserves source identifiers and weights for handoff. It does not independently corroborate demand, but it correctly preserves provenance for the supplied records.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid treating provenance as independent demand corroboration
